initiative.title: A project's agent on its page
initiative.body: Members talk to a project's agent on the project page and it makes targeted, approved edits to the project. Runs on a Coax port of the Claude Agent SDK on our hosted agent runner.

milestones.title: Talk to the project agent on the page
milestones.body: The Coax Claude Agent SDK, the runner, oa-api sessions and the page panel.

tasks.title: Coax Claude Agent SDK: transport and messages
tasks.body:
Port the transport and stream messages of the Rust crate claude_agent_sdk (0b401561a0^:crates/claude_agent_sdk) to Coax: spawn `claude` with stream-json in and out in its own process group through a C shim in coax/platform/, read lines, parse every SDKMessage type into typed values, unknown types kept raw.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: Recorded stream-json fixtures from the crate's tests parse the same way
A live smoke runs one query against the installed CLI and prints the result and cost
Killing a query stops the whole process group

tasks.title: Coax Claude Agent SDK: control protocol, permissions and SDK MCP tools
tasks.body:
initialize, can_use_tool, hook_callback, mcp_message, interrupt, set_model and set_permission_mode, both ways; QueryOptions into flags and initialize fields; an in-process SDK MCP server for typed tools.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: The live smoke calls one in-process MCP tool and denies a built-in tool through the permission callback
Control fixtures from the crate's tests pass

tasks.title: oa-api: agent sessions, events, queue and approvals
tasks.body:
Session and event tables shaped like openagents.agent.managed.v1, a member message queue, turn records for UNDO TURN, an approved-projects list, and a signed wake call to the runner. Members use their session cookie; the runner uses the project's agent key.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A non-approved project's agent routes answer the same not found
UNDO TURN restores the document version from before the turn

tasks.title: oa-agent runner on Cloud Run
tasks.body:
Container with the claude CLI and the Coax SDK binary, the project MCP tools from the spec, Read/Glob/Grep/Edit/Write limited to a per-turn checkout of the linked repository (Bash and web off), one commit per turn pushed with a deploy key from Secret Manager, Claude Sonnet 5.5, the Anthropic key from Secret Manager in the child environment only, a daily spend cap and one turn at a time per project. Scale to zero.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A wake runs one turn and streams its events to oa-api on staging
A turn that edits a file pushes one commit; UNDO TURN pushes its revert
The key appears in no log, event or response
Over the cap, the turn refuses and the page says why

tasks.title: The AGENT panel on a project page
tasks.body:
Conversation, text box, a working line, STOP, and diff cards for each document edit and commit, UNDO TURN, and NEEDS BOTH on proposed goals; drawn in Coax; polling while a turn runs.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A member's message gets an answer and an applied edit on staging, desktop and phone (headless shots)
UNDO TURN puts the document and the repository back

tasks.title: Project agent live for the first approved project
tasks.body:
End to end on production for the first approved project, with the spend cap set.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: Both members can talk to it on production
The edit log shows each change with the message that caused it
